svg.data-power-supply-capacity-w: 3000 W per supply (3150 W for the N9K-PUV2-3000W-B), up to four
svg.data-cooling-path: front-to-back; air enters at the line-card and power-supply side, leaves at the fan trays
svg.data-fan-trays: three, FAN 1 to FAN 3, on the rear face
